Describe the expected and observed behavior.

Provide the policy/app version, platform, and commands using synthetic paths.

Include an entirely synthetic reproduction. Do not attach patient DICOMs, original patient identifiers, real filenames, credentials or unredacted logs. Security-sensitive disclosures belong in the private reporting channel described in SECURITY.md.
